page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c1.large is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.c1 server family. Built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor, this instance features 8 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory. The hardware configuration establishes a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, allocating exactly 2.0 GB of memory per core.

This server does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage volumes. It does not feature integrated GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that compute resources are not shared with other tenants, providing predictable processing capabilities for workloads that do not require local disk access or graphics acceleration.

The ecs.c1.large is designed for compute-intensive workloads that require dedicated CPU resources but have moderate memory requirements. Suitable applications include web serving, batch processing, distributed analytics nodes, and application servers where external database or storage systems are utilized.
